title: FMVSS barrier review
summary: NHTSA requested public comment on standards that might impede certification or testing of ADS vehicles without human driving controls. This request did not amend a standard.
takeaway: NHTSA requested public comment on standards that might impede certification or testing of ADS vehicles without human driving controls

title: Removing regulatory barriers for ADS vehicles
summary: Advanced notice sought input on adapting crash avoidance standards for vehicles without traditional manual controls; it did not change an FMVSS.
takeaway: Advanced notice sought input on adapting crash avoidance standards for vehicles without traditional manual controls; it did not change an FMVSS

title: Occupant protection proposal
summary: Proposed adapting 11 numbered crash protection standards for ADS vehicles without conventional driving controls; the final rule later added changes to 212 and 219.
takeaway: Proposed adapting 11 numbered crash protection standards for ADS vehicles without conventional driving controls; the final rule later added changes to 212 and 219

title: Occupant protection final rule
summary: Amended 13 numbered standards for ADS vehicles without traditional manual driving controls, including FMVSS 204's exclusion for vehicles without steering controls. This addresses vehicle crash protection, not ADS driving performance.
takeaway: Amended 13 numbered standards for ADS vehicles without traditional manual driving controls, including FMVSS 204's exclusion for vehicles without steering controls

title: Steering control rearward displacement · FMVSS 204
summary: A separate, generally applicable rule excludes vehicles certified to FMVSS 208 frontal barrier crash protection from FMVSS 204's steering column rearward displacement requirements and removes obsolete text. It is relevant to AV design but is not an ADS-specific rule.
takeaway: Exempts FMVSS 208-certified vehicles from the steering-column displacement test

title: Transmission displays · FMVSS 102
summary: Proposed changes to requirements written around human-operated transmission controls in ADS-equipped vehicles.
takeaway: Would adapt transmission-display rules for vehicles without manual controls

title: Defrosting and windshield wiping · FMVSS 103/104
summary: Proposed changes to defrosting and wiping requirements for ADS vehicles without conventional driver controls.
takeaway: Would adapt defrosting and wiper rules for driverless designs

title: Tire placards · FMVSS 110
summary: Proposed adapting tire information placard requirements to ADS-equipped vehicle designs.
takeaway: Would adapt tire-information placards for ADS vehicle designs

title: Brake controls · FMVSS 135
summary: Proposed removing the manual brake pedal requirement for vehicles designed exclusively for ADS operation while retaining braking performance requirements.
takeaway: Would remove the brake-pedal requirement for ADS-only vehicles; braking standards remain

title: FMVSS 201 · Interior impact
summary: Revised interior impact applicability and test references for vehicles without a conventional driver's seating position.
takeaway: Adapts interior-impact tests for vehicles without a driver seat

title: FMVSS 203 · Steering control impact
summary: Excluded vehicles without steering controls from the steering control impact standard.
takeaway: Exempts vehicles without steering controls from steering-control impact tests

title: FMVSS 204 · Steering control rearward displacement
summary: Excluded vehicles without steering controls from the steering column displacement standard.
takeaway: Exempts vehicles without steering controls from steering-column displacement tests

title: FMVSS 205 · Glazing materials
summary: Updated the glazing standard's application to trucks designed to carry at least one person.
takeaway: Updates glazing rules for trucks designed to carry occupants

title: FMVSS 206 · Door locks and retention
summary: Updated door definitions and applicability for vehicles without a conventional driver's seating position.
takeaway: Updates door-lock rules for vehicles without a conventional driver seat

title: FMVSS 207 · Seating systems
summary: Required a designated driver's seat only where manually operated driving controls are present.
takeaway: Requires a driver seat only when manual driving controls are present

title: FMVSS 208 · Occupant crash protection
summary: Revised crash protection requirements, seating terminology and test procedures for vehicles without manual driving controls.
takeaway: Adapts occupant crash protection and testing for vehicles without manual controls

title: FMVSS 212 · Windshield mounting
summary: Conforming applicability change for trucks designed to carry at least one person, added in the final rule.
takeaway: Updates windshield-mounting coverage for trucks carrying occupants

title: FMVSS 214 · Side impact protection
summary: Revised side impact test procedures and seating references for vehicles without traditional driver controls.
takeaway: Adapts side-impact tests for vehicles without conventional driver controls

title: FMVSS 216a · Roof crush resistance
summary: Updated applicability and test setup for roof crush protection in vehicles designed to carry occupants.
takeaway: Updates roof-crush test setup for vehicles designed to carry occupants

title: FMVSS 219 · Windshield zone intrusion
summary: Conforming applicability change for trucks designed to carry at least one person, added in the final rule.
takeaway: Updates windshield-intrusion coverage for trucks carrying occupants

title: FMVSS 225 · Child restraint anchorages
summary: Revised the shuttle bus definition to account for buses without manual driving controls.
takeaway: Updates the shuttle-bus definition for buses without manual controls

title: FMVSS 226 · Ejection mitigation
summary: Updated applicability and test setup for ejection mitigation in vehicles without conventional driver controls.
takeaway: Adapts ejection-mitigation tests for vehicles without conventional driver controls
